newsitem.title: USA: Solv-Ex short selling under investigation.
newsitem.headline: Solv-Ex short selling under investigation.

text.p: Solv-Ex Corp said it has been informed that it a federal grand jury is investigating short selling by third parties in Solv-Ex common stock.

The company said it was "extremely pleased" with this development and planned to assist in the proceedings in any way possible. It said the U.S. Attorney's Office informed it that the comany is not the subject or a target of the investigation.
Last August, Solv-Ex filed a civil action against several parties for what it said were improper actions relating to a campaign to drive down the price of its shares.
